name: Copper Comet
tagline: The operating system for the furnace whisperers building tomorrow's home comfort empire.
positioning: Copper Comet turns solo HVAC operators into fleets of legend — dispatch, quoting, and service agreements orbiting one screen.

hero.h1: Run your HVAC empire from the driver's seat.
hero.sub: Copper Comet is the destined command center for owner-operators — booking calls, dispatching trucks, and collecting payment before the compressor cools down.

features.title: Dispatch that reads the road
features.description: Drag a job onto a tech, and Copper Comet reshuffles the whole day around traffic, skill match, and drive time — no more phone-tag dispatching from a whiteboard.

features.title: Quotes signed on the tailgate
features.description: Build a good-better-best replacement quote in 90 seconds, capture the signature on your phone, and take the deposit before you pack up the ladder.

features.title: Maintenance plans on autopilot
features.description: Enroll customers in seasonal service agreements once and let recurring visits, reminders, and invoices generate themselves — predictable revenue while you sleep.

features.title: Parts truck inventory
features.description: Every capacitor and blower motor tracked per van, auto-deducted at close-out, and flagged for reorder so techs never drive back for a $12 part.

features.title: Get paid at the curb
features.description: Tap-to-pay, financing offers, and automatic follow-ups on aging invoices turn 60-day receivables into same-day deposits.

features.title: The whole shop, one dashboard
features.description: First-time-fix rate, revenue per tech, and callback trends surfaced in plain English — the numbers that decide whether you hire truck number two.

testimonials.quote: We went from a shoebox of paper tickets to closing 14 install quotes a week. Copper Comet paid for itself before the first invoice cleared.
testimonials.name: Marcus DeLeon

testimonials.quote: Dispatching used to eat my whole morning. Now the board builds itself and my techs stop asking me where they're going next.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramankutty

testimonials.quote: The maintenance plan engine alone added 40 recurring contracts our first quarter. It's like the software wants us to grow.
testimonials.name: Chuck Boland

pricing.blurb: For the one-truck operator ready to look like a ten-truck outfit.
For growing shops running multiple trucks and real payroll.
For multi-location operators building the comfort dynasty.

homepage.footerBlurb: Copper Comet is the field service operating system for HVAC owner-operators with bigger plans than their calendar can hold.
